items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'We're going down to City Hall because I'm going to fix it so you don't leave me no more.'

ctx.x: So she come to Boston. I'll never forget it. So she told me she couldn't continue living with me, she said. She said, 'I'll have to go back home. I can't continue living with you.' I said, 'Well, I'm going to fix that.' So we got up the next morning and I said, 'C'mon, we're going downtown.' She said, 'What are we going down there for?' I said, 'We're going down to City Hall because I'm going to fix it so you don't leave me no more.'
That sounds like the last story.
